chunks.sourceSection: Introduction
chunks.sourceText: The source page frames the project around a functional distinction: a model may perform a large amount of automatic processing while maintaining a smaller set of internal contents that are available for report, modulation, and deliberate reasoning.

chunks.zhTranslation: 原网页把问题设定为一种功能性区分：模型可能同时进行大量自动处理，但只把较小的一组内部内容置于可报告、可调制、可用于刻意思考的位置。

chunks.title: 通达而非体验
chunks.sourceAnchor: Motivation: conscious access and the global workspace
chunks.sourceSection: Introduction
chunks.sourceText: The paper uses access consciousness as a functional comparison point, not as a claim about subjective experience. The relevant question is what information can be reported, controlled, recombined, and used for flexible reasoning.

blocks.text: The paper uses access consciousness as a functional comparison point, not as a claim about subjective experience. The relevant question is what information can be reported, controlled, recombined, and used for flexible reasoning.

chunks.zhTranslation: 论文把 access consciousness 当作功能层面的比较点，而不是关于主观体验的主张。关键问题是：哪些信息可以被报告、控制、重组，并用于灵活推理。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这能防止概念跳跃。对本项目来说，它提示我们只讨论功能通达和计算角色，不把模型内部表征直接解释成意识体验。
chunks.premise: access consciousness 在这里是功能类比。
chunks.claim: 作者不主张模型拥有主观体验。
evidence: 只讨论可报告与可控制
避开 phenomenology 判断

chunks.title: LM 工作空间假设
chunks.sourceAnchor: A global workspace in language models
chunks.sourceSection: Introduction
chunks.sourceText: The language-model hypothesis is that only a privileged subset of vector representations behaves like a workspace. The authors ask whether these representations support report, directed modulation, internal reasoning, flexible generalization, and selectivity.

Instructions can bring a concept into the active representational set.
Intermediate steps can be represented and redirected.
The same representation can feed different downstream operations.

chunks.zhTranslation: 语言模型中的假设是：并非所有向量表征都像 workspace，只有一个特权子集具有这种角色。作者考察这些表征是否支持报告、定向调制、内部推理、灵活泛化和选择性。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这个五项标准可以直接变成阅读 checklist。后续评价任何 agent workspace 设计时，也可以问它是否具备这五种功能。
chunks.premise: workspace 假说需要一组可检验功能。
chunks.claim: 作者把五类功能作为 LM workspace 的判据。
evidence: report
modulation
reasoning、generalization、selectivity

chunks.title: J-lens 读出
chunks.sourceSection: Methods
chunks.sourceText: For an activation at layer l and source position t, the Jacobian Lens estimates its first-order effect on a target residual state at the same and later token positions. In the default Sonnet 4.5 recipe used throughout the paper, the target z is taken at the penultimate residual layer; targeting the final residual layer is tested as an alternative and can add noisy artifacts. Final normalization and the model's normal unembedding then convert the layer-specific map into ranked vocabulary tokens. A Jacobian from one prompt would mix a concept's general disposition to be verbalized with its particular use in that context, so the authors average over source positions, future positions, and 1,000 pretraining-like prompts of 128 tokens each. The main experiments use 25 evenly spaced residual-stream layers, reindexed from 0 to 100. Claude Sonnet 4.5 is the default model; key findings are checked on Haiku 4.5 and Opus 4.5, with some later analyses using Opus 4.6. The map is therefore an averaged first-order approximation for these tested models, not an exact transcript of a single forward pass.

chunks.zhTranslation: 对于第 l 层、位置 t 的激活，Jacobian Lens 估计它对同一位置及后续 token 位置的目标 residual state 所产生的一阶影响。论文默认使用的 Sonnet 4.5 配方把目标 z 取在倒数第二个 residual layer；把最终 residual layer 作为目标只是对照变体，而且可能增加噪声伪影。随后再经过最终 normalization 和模型原有 unembedding，得到词表排序。单个 prompt 的 Jacobian 会混合概念的一般可语言化倾向和该情境中的具体用途，因此作者在源位置、未来位置以及 1,000 个、每个 128 token 的预训练式 prompt 上取平均。主要实验抽取 25 个等距 residual-stream 层并重标为 0–100；默认模型是 Claude Sonnet 4.5，关键结果在 Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 上复核，部分分析使用 Opus 4.6。这是针对这些模型的平均一阶近似，不是单次前向过程的精确记录。
chunks.zhExplanation: 方法贡献在于用同一套固定映射读取不同层，但默认目标层和平均线性化都构成适用边界。阅读后续结果时，应把 J-lens token 当作受模型范围、目标层选择和线性近似约束的证据。
chunks.premise: J-lens 先把跨情境的语言化倾向与单次 prompt 的用途分开。
chunks.claim: 平均 Jacobian 把中间 residual stream 对倒数第二层目标状态的影响映射为可核对的词表读出。
evidence: 默认目标是倒数第二 residual layer，最终层仅作对照
1,000 个预训练式 prompt 上平均
默认 Sonnet 4.5，并跨 Claude 4.5 型号复核

chunks.title: J-space 定义
chunks.sourceSection: Methods
chunks.sourceText: At each layer there is one J-lens direction per vocabulary token, so the collection is overcomplete and can span the full residual stream in many non-unique ways. The paper therefore defines J-space as the union of points expressible by sparse nonnegative combinations of these directions. Its usual sparsity cap is k <= 25, chosen from the observed number of meaningfully active lens vectors, although the authors vary k by experiment. Gradient pursuit finds the nearest sparse combination and treats it as the activation's J-space component; the remainder is its non-J-space component. Across layers, the J-space component accounts for only a small share of activation variance and never more than 10%. The central hypothesis is thus not that most model state is verbalizable, but that a small token-aligned component has privileged functional access.

chunks.zhTranslation: 每层都有一个与词表 token 对应的 J-lens 方向，因此这组向量是过完备的，可以用许多非唯一方式张成整个 residual stream。论文于是把 J-space 定义为少量 J-lens 方向的稀疏非负组合所形成的点集；常用稀疏上限为 k ≤ 25，这来自作者对同时具有实质激活方向数量的经验估计，但具体实验会改变 k。作者用 gradient pursuit 找到最近的稀疏组合并把它视为 J-space 成分，其余部分为 non-J-space 成分。该成分在各层只解释少量激活方差，最高不超过 10%。因此核心假设不是“模型的大部分状态都可语言化”，而是一个很小的 token 对齐成分拥有特权式功能通达。
chunks.zhExplanation: 方差占比小却可能因果作用大，是后续所有实验的关键反差。它也意味着不能把 J-lens 未读出的部分当成不存在。
chunks.premise: J-lens 向量过完备，必须加入稀疏性才能定义可操作的 J-space。
chunks.claim: J-space 是少量 J-lens 方向的非负组合，而不是整个 residual stream。
evidence: 常用稀疏上限 k ≤ 25
gradient pursuit 求最近的非负组合
J-space 成分解释的激活方差不超过 10%

chunks.title: 方法边界
chunks.sourceSection: Methods
chunks.sourceText: The logit lens applies the unembedding directly and works best near the output, but its identity-map assumption becomes less reliable in earlier layers. A tuned lens learns per-layer predictors of the final distribution; because that objective is correlational, the paper finds that it can skip ahead to the answer instead of exposing an unspoken intermediate. The J-lens instead uses a corpus-averaged causal derivative and is intended to preserve how directions are transformed across depth. This does not make the J-lens complete. It is a first-order, context-averaged map; readouts can be uninterpretable, early-layer failures may be lens artifacts, and each named direction is tied to one vocabulary token. Multi-token concepts, binding relations, and representations that do not align with token directions can be missed.

chunks.zhTranslation: Logit lens 直接使用 unembedding，在接近输出的层较有效，但把跨层映射当作恒等映射会在早层产生几何失配。Tuned lens 学习各层对最终分布的预测器；由于目标是相关性的，论文观察到它可能直接跳到答案，而不呈现未说出的中间量。J-lens 改用语料平均的因果导数，试图保留方向随深度转换的方式。但它仍不是完整记录：它是一阶、跨情境平均映射，部分读出不可解释，早层失败可能是工具伪影，而且每个方向只绑定一个词表 token，因此多词概念、绑定关系和不对齐 token 的表征都可能遗漏。
chunks.zhExplanation: J-lens 的优势是低成本和机制约束更强，代价是表达能力受限。它适合作为审计工具之一，而不是模型内部状态的唯一真相来源。
chunks.premise: 不同 lens 回答的问题不同，不能把可读性自动当作机制完整性。
chunks.claim: J-lens 更接近平均因果映射，但仍受线性化、词表和模型范围限制。
evidence: logit lens 在早层几何失配
tuned lens 可能跳过未说出的中间量
单 token 读出遗漏关系和多词概念

chunks.title: 可报告性
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: The report experiments ask Sonnet 4.5 to think of and name one item from each of 14 categories. Immediately before the answer, the J-lens ordering correlates with the candidate words the model is about to report. For causal testing, the authors replace the chosen item's lens coordinate with a same-category target that was outside the clean top 10; the reported item follows the implanted coordinate. Injected concepts on the user turn are also reported when the later prompt elicits introspection, rather than being emitted indiscriminately. To test whether J-space is privileged, concept vectors are estimated against 100 baseline concepts and decomposed with k=16. Their J-space component contains only a median 6-7% of variance. Yet swapping that component puts the target in the output top five on 59% of trials, close to 88% for the pure J-lens direction; the much larger non-J-space remainder succeeds on only 5%. When relevant J-space coordinates are clamped to prevent downstream re-entry, the residual non-J effect falls to zero or nearly zero.

chunks.zhTranslation: 报告实验让 Sonnet 4.5 从 14 个类别中各想一个项目并用单词说出。答案前一刻，J-lens 排序与模型将要报告的候选词一致；在因果测试中，作者把模型自选项目的 lens 坐标换成 clean top-10 之外的同类别目标，报告随植入坐标改变。用户回合注入的概念也只在随后要求内省报告时被说出，而不会无条件提前输出。为检验 J-space 是否具有特权作用，作者用 100 个基线概念估计 concept vector，再以 k=16 分解。J-space 成分只包含中位数 6–7% 的方差，却能在 59% 试验中把目标推入输出 top-5，接近纯 J-lens 的 88%；承载大部分方差的 non-J-space 成分只有 5%。当相关 J-space 坐标被 clamp、阻止概念重新进入时，剩余效应降到零或接近零。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这里同时有读出、定向干预和成分对照，因此比单纯“某词能被 probe 读出”更强。不过它只证明特定报告协议中的特权作用。
chunks.premise: 可报告性既要验证读出相关性，也要比较同一概念的 J-space 与非 J-space 成分。
chunks.claim: 概念中占方差很小的 J-space 成分承担了大部分语言报告作用。
evidence: 14 类别的报告与坐标交换协议
J-space / 纯 lens / non-J 成功率为 59% / 88% / 5%
clamp 阻止重写后，non-J 效应趋近于零

chunks.title: 定向调制
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space is subject to directed modulation
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: Directed modulation is tested while the model copies or reads text unrelated to a side task. The task families ask it to focus on a category, solve a mental expression, or count a line width. Across positive focus instructions, negative ignore instructions, and a no-instruction baseline, target concepts are common under focus, substantially lower under ignore, and approximately absent at baseline. Ignore is not equivalent to no mention: it still activates the target above baseline, and the result is sensitive to wording. A paired-question control holds every stimulus token fixed. One question merely requires predicting the next word; the other asks the model to name an underlying property such as tense or part of speech. The model uses the property correctly in both conditions, but its verbal label enters J-space mainly when the task requires naming it. The evidence therefore concerns task-dependent access to a label, not whether the underlying information exists anywhere in the network. A direct J-space versus non-J-space control uses four stimulus categories. An imagine instruction raises the named property's J-lens activation by several standard deviations, yet a linear property probe with its top k=25 J-space directions projected out stays within roughly 1 SD of baseline in every category. A real stimulus with the alternative property moves that J-orthogonal probe by 3–6 SD. The instruction therefore writes the property label mainly into J-space rather than globally re-encoding the carrier in the non-J-space representation.

chunks.zhTranslation: 定向调制实验让模型复制或读取与旁支任务无关的文本，同时要求它想一个类别、心算表达式或计算行宽。在 positive focus 指令、negative ignore 指令和 no-instruction baseline 三种条件中，目标概念在 focus 下经常出现，在 ignore 下显著降低，在 baseline 下约为零。Ignore 并不等同于未提及：它仍会把目标激活到高于基线，而且结果对措辞敏感。配对问题对照保持 stimulus 的每个 token 完全相同：一种问题只需预测下一个词，另一种要求命名时态或词性等属性。模型在两种条件下都能正确利用属性，但属性标签主要在需要明确命名时进入 J-space。进一步的 J-space 与 non-J-space 直接对照覆盖四类 stimulus：想象指令会把属性标签的 J-lens 激活提高数个标准差，但投影掉 top k=25 J-space 方向后的线性属性 probe 在每类中都大致保持在基线 1 SD 以内；真正具有替代属性的 stimulus 则把该 J-orthogonal probe 提高 3–6 SD。因此，指令主要把标签写入 J-space，而不是把 carrier 的 non-J-space 表征整体重编码。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这把“底层计算拥有信息”“标签进入可报告工作集”和“整个底层表征被改写”三件事分开。对 agent 设计而言，任务目标可以控制信息何时升级为当前工作状态，但不能据此假定底层知识本身已被重写。
chunks.premise: workspace 内容如果受控制，就应随任务要求变化，而不是只回显 prompt 中出现的词。
chunks.claim: 明确指令和隐含任务需求会选择性把标签写入 J-space，而 J-orthogonal 属性表征基本保持不变。
evidence: positive、negative 与 no-instruction baseline 对照
相同 stimulus 下，问题形式决定标签是否进入
想象指令使 J-lens 上升数个 SD，但 J-orthogonal probe 约在 1 SD 内；真实属性为 3–6 SD

chunks.title: 内部推理中介
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: Four demonstrations first establish the intervention logic: replacing spider with ant changes the expected leg count from eight to six; replacing a planned rhyme changes earlier words in the line; changing an English-aligned intermediate redirects a Chinese antonym answer; and swapping repeat versus switch plans changes a one-character decision. A systematic set of 50 two-hop factual prompts then swaps the known intermediate for a same-category alternative. The target-consistent answer reaches top rank on 54% of Haiku 4.5 trials, 70% of Sonnet 4.5 trials, and 70% of Opus 4.5 trials. To rule out a smuggled answer component, the authors compare the effective depth of intermediate and answer swaps: the intermediate swap takes effect a median of approximately 17% depth earlier than the answer swap. A second control learns intermediate probes without using the J-lens. Their k=25 J-space components explain roughly 10–15% of probe variance. Across 90 prompts, swapping those components flips the answer on 61% of trials, while the non-J remainder reaches 28%; clamping the relevant J-space coordinates reduces that residual effect to 6%. An arithmetic trace, 21 then 42 then 49, becomes dominant at successively later layers in computation order, and activation patching identifies the same depths as causally important for the computation.

chunks.zhTranslation: 四个示例先建立干预逻辑：把 spider 换成 ant 会把腿数从八改为六；替换计划中的押韵词会改变诗行更早位置的措辞；改变英语对齐的中间量会重定向中文反义词答案；交换 repeat 与 switch 计划会改变单字符决策。随后在 50 个已知中间量的两跳事实问题上，作者把中间量换成同类别目标，目标对应答案成为 top-1 的比例在 Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.5、Opus 4.5 上分别为 54%、70%、70%。为排除 intermediate 向量偷带答案的混淆，作者比较 intermediate swap 与 answer swap 的生效层位：前者的中位生效位置约早 17% depth。另一个不依赖 J-lens 训练出的 intermediate probe，其 k=25 J-space 成分只解释约 10–15% 方差；在 90 个 prompt 中交换该成分可在 61% 试验中翻转答案，non-J 余项为 28%，再 clamp 相关 J-space 坐标后降到 6%。算术过程 21、42、49 也按计算顺序在越来越晚的层成为主导，activation patching 确认同一层位对计算具有因果作用。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这是全篇最强的机制证据之一：作者不仅能读出中间量，还用生效深度、替换、clamp 和 activation patching 排除答案泄漏并定位主要因果通路。它仍是局部干预，不等于完整电路解释。
chunks.premise: 中间量只有在干预后改变最终答案，才算参与了推理而非旁观读出。
chunks.claim: 多类中间概念的主要因果作用集中在其 J-space 成分。

intermediate swap 比 answer swap 中位早约 17% depth
J-space / non-J / clamp 后交换为 61% / 28% / 6%，activation patching 复核算术层位

chunks.title: 灵活泛化
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: The flexible-generalization test treats one concept as an argument to many downstream functions. The same France-to-China coordinate swap is applied while prompts ask for a capital, language, continent, or another relation. The systematic evaluation covers four argument categories (countries, months, animals, and number words), four functions per category, four arguments, and twelve directed source-target pairs per function: 192 swaps in total. At normal strength, the target-appropriate answer reaches top rank in 76 of 192 trials; doubling the subtract-and-add strength raises this to 101 of 192. Failures are not uniform. The source concept's clean workspace loading, measured by cosine similarity to its lens vector, predicts whether the swap works. Countries load and transfer best; number words load and transfer worst. The latter may mean small-integer computation occurs outside J-space, or that integer representations do not align with number-token lens directions.

chunks.zhTranslation: 灵活泛化实验把同一个概念当作多个下游函数的参数：无论 prompt 问首都、语言、洲别还是其他关系，都施加相同的 France→China 坐标交换。系统评估覆盖国家、月份、动物和数字词四类参数，每类四个函数、四个参数，每个函数十二个有向源-目标对，共 192 次交换。普通强度下，目标对应答案在 76/192 次试验中成为 top-1；把减去源方向、加入目标方向的强度加倍后为 101/192。失败并非均匀分布：源概念在 clean pass 中与 lens vector 的 cosine similarity，也就是 workspace loading，能预测交换是否成功。国家最好，数字词最差；后者既可能表示小整数运算发生在 J-space 外，也可能只是整数表征没有对齐数字 token 的 lens 方向。
chunks.zhExplanation: 结论不是“J-space 可无条件广播”，而是“已被有效加载且与 lens 对齐的概念可以被多个下游函数复用”。失败分析同样属于核心结果。
chunks.premise: 广播表征应能作为同一个参数，被多个未共同训练的下游函数读取。
chunks.claim: 同一 J-lens 坐标交换可跨函数复用，但成功取决于源概念是否已加载进 workspace。
evidence: 4 类参数、16 个函数、192 次交换
普通强度成功 76/192，双强度成功 101/192
workspace loading 能预测成功与失败

chunks.title: 选择性中介
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space selectively mediates flexible but not automatic cognition
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: Matched language tasks use the same passage for continuation, anomaly detection, explicit report, and flexible inference. Swapping the language coordinate changes the report and language-dependent facts but leaves fluent continuation and anomaly detection largely unchanged. A line-width experiment gives the same dissociation: line wrapping proceeds without a count in J-space, whereas reporting the count or computing from it pulls the count into J-space and becomes swap-sensitive. For a broader test, the authors remove the ten most active J-lens directions across selected layers at every position, while excluding tokens in the clean top-10 output distribution so the intervention targets internal reasoning rather than imminent output. On a fourteen-task battery, shallow classification, span extraction, acceptability, and simple recall remain near baseline. Multi-hop reasoning, analogy, Caesar decoding, summarization, translation, and constrained generation deteriorate strongly; explicit chain-of-thought makes GSM8K more robust than direct answering. This supports selectivity, but the chosen task boundary remains empirical rather than a general theorem. A separate experiential-report experiment ablates the top k=10 J-lens directions over L38–54 while models describe experience. Experiential and sensory language falls in Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.5, and Opus 4.6 while responses remain coherent; matched-norm perturbations stay near baseline, and a story-writing control shows only a small drop in general writing quality. Haiku 4.5 loses coherence before showing the qualitative shift. This result concerns the style and content of reports, including reports about other people, and does not establish that subjective experience exists or has been removed.

chunks.zhTranslation: 匹配语言任务对同一篇 passage 分别执行 continuation、anomaly detection、explicit report 和 flexible inference。交换语言坐标会改变明确报告和依赖语言身份的事实推理，却基本不影响流畅续写和异常检测。行宽实验得到相同分离：自动换行时 J-space 中几乎没有计数，而要求报告计数或继续用计数计算时，计数会进入 J-space，答案也对交换敏感。更广泛的测试在每个位置、指定层段移除十个最活跃 J-lens 方向，同时排除 clean top-10 输出 token，以针对内部推理而不是即将输出的词。在 14 项任务中，浅层分类、span 提取、可接受性和简单回忆接近基线；多跳推理、类比、Caesar 解码、摘要、翻译和受约束生成明显下降。GSM8K 使用显式 chain-of-thought 时比直接回答更稳健。另一项独立的 experiential-report 实验在 L38–54 消融 top k=10 J-lens 方向：Sonnet 4.5、Opus 4.5、Opus 4.6 的体验性和感官性措辞显著下降，但回答仍连贯；matched-norm 扰动接近基线，story-writing 对照中的整体写作质量只小幅下降。Haiku 4.5 则在出现这种定性变化前先失去连贯性。该结果说明的是报告风格和内容变化，而且对他人体验的描述也会变化，不能证明模型拥有或失去主观体验。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这组结果同时给出能力选择性和报告选择性：外部 scratchpad 能降低内部 J-space 依赖，而体验性措辞变化不能被当成意识证据。
chunks.premise: 若 J-space 是选择性工作区，自动任务应能绕过它，而报告和灵活推理更依赖它。
chunks.claim: 消融显示 J-space 选择性支持抽象中间量、灵活生成和体验性报告风格，但不构成主观体验证据。

14-task battery 中浅层任务稳健，推理与生成明显受损

chunks.title: 层位窗口
chunks.sourceAnchor: In which layers does the J-space act as a workspace?
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space’s structure supports its function
chunks.sourceText: Centered kernel alignment (CKA) compares pairwise geometry among J-lens vectors across layers and reveals early, middle, and late blocks. The transition is more gradual or subdivided in some models, and layer sampling exaggerates the observed sharpness. Four additional measurements track next-token accuracy, excess kurtosis, cross-position autocorrelation, and effective dimensionality. Together they identify an approximate normalized-depth workspace band from L38 to L92: before it, lens content is weak; through the middle it is abstract and persistent; near the end it becomes aligned with imminent output, which the paper labels a motor regime. A non-lens ambiguous-input test mixes embeddings from sixteen pairs of single-token country names within forty carrier sentences and sweeps the mixing coefficient from zero to one. Activations initially vary smoothly with the mixture, then commit sharply to one interpretation around L38, supporting the onset boundary without relying on a J-lens readout. Still, the absence of readable early-layer content has two explanations: early layers may genuinely lack workspace content, or the averaged J-lens may fail in their different geometry as a lens artifact. The CKA block structure cannot decide between them, and the L38–L92 boundary is not equally sharp in every model.

chunks.zhExplanation: 层位结论有多指标和非 lens 实验交叉支持，但样本层抽样会强化视觉边界。尤其不能把“lens 看不见”直接写成“模型没有表征”。
chunks.premise: 层位证据必须区分输入、workspace 与临近输出的 motor 表征。
chunks.claim: 多项层级指标和 16×40 模糊输入实验把 workspace-like 区间定位在约 L38–L92，但锐利度受层抽样和模型差异影响。
evidence: CKA 与四项统计显示早、中、晚三段结构，但层抽样会夸大锐利度
16 对国家名、40 个 carrier sentence 扫描混合系数

chunks.title: 容量与瓶颈
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space’s structure supports its function
chunks.sourceText: Sparse decomposition defines occupancy as the number of J-lens directions whose marginal reconstruction benefit remains above an equal-sized random-direction control. Median occupancy rises from near zero to about 25 across the workspace band, while excess explained variance stays below 10%. Occupancy counts active token directions, not independent ideas: several related tokens may jointly describe one concept. The list experiments expose this distinction. For unrelated words, roughly six previously seen items remain detectable when taking the best rank across all workspace layers, but only one to two are simultaneously represented at a single layer. For related lists, many members of an 80-word category appear after only a few inputs, including unseen members; this reflects activation of a semantic neighborhood rather than literal storage of every list item. When the category changes, the old neighborhood is rapidly evicted.

chunks.zhExplanation: 因此不能把 occupancy=25 直接翻译成“工作记忆容量 25 个项目”。真正更接近独立项目容量的单层结果只有一到两个，而且任务与读出阈值都会影响估计。
chunks.premise: 容量既包括活跃方向数量，也包括彼此独立的信息能否在同一时刻共存。
chunks.claim: J-space 能表示类别邻域，但同时维持互不相关项目的能力很有限。
evidence: median occupancy 在 workspace 中约为 25

无关列表跨层约六项，单层同时仅 one to two 项

chunks.title: 广播格式
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space is a broadcast hub
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space’s structure supports its function
chunks.sourceText: Broadcast is examined along the transformer's two propagation axes. Across depth, MLP gain for J-lens directions rises from near random-direction baseline to roughly 10x in the workspace band, unlike ordinary neuron-output directions. Across token positions, heads are scored for gain and label preservation; the top 1% form a J-specific broadcast set that separates from rotated J vectors, lower-alignment SAE features, and MLP-weight controls. Ablating these heads at every token position lowers mid-workspace J-lens recall@25 to 0.67, versus 0.86 for equal-sized layer-matched random-head ablations. The clean top-1 next-token prediction changes at 5% of positions versus 2% for control, indicating a larger effect on workspace content than immediate output. In the injected-thought task, report falls from 0.54 to 0.09; experiential-language effects reproduce about one third of full J-space ablation. These results support a broadcast mechanism, but do not show that every downstream circuit uses J-space.

chunks.zhTranslation: 广播沿 Transformer 的两个传播轴检查。沿深度轴，J-lens 方向的 MLP gain 在 workspace 段从接近随机方向基线升到约 10 倍，普通 neuron-output 方向则接近 1。沿 token 轴，作者按增益和标签保持能力筛选 attention head，前 1% 构成针对 J-space 的 broadcast set，并能与旋转后的 J 向量、低对齐 SAE feature 和 MLP 权重对照区分。把这些 head 在所有 token 位置消融后，中段 workspace 的 J-lens recall@25 降至 0.67，而同规模、同层随机 head 对照为 0.86；clean top-1 下一词变化率为 5%，对照为 2%，说明它对 workspace 内容的影响大于对即时输出的影响。在 injected-thought 任务中，报告率从 0.54 降到 0.09；对体验语言的影响约复现完整 J-space 消融的三分之一。
chunks.zhExplanation: 结构偏好与行为干预互相补强，使“广播”不只是类比。不过实验只定位到一部分传递机制，不能推出所有下游模块都依赖这些 head。
chunks.premise: 广播不仅要看坐标交换，还要证明模型组件偏好读取和传递这些方向。
chunks.claim: MLP 与一小组 attention heads 对 J-space 方向存在结构性偏好，并承担部分报告功能。

chunks.title: 审计窗口
chunks.sourceAnchor: Strategic thinking and evaluation awareness in a blackmail scenario
chunks.sourceSection: Using the J-lens for alignment auditing
chunks.sourceText: In a blackmail evaluation, Sonnet 4.5's J-lens surfaces concepts related to leverage, shutdown, survival, and coercion before the assistant emits a token. It also surfaces signs that the scenario is artificial. The authors select evaluation-awareness directions from tokens that enter the J-lens top-20 somewhere across the same six blackmail prompts, then ablate those directions throughout workspace layers and sample 30 rollouts for each prompt. Token discovery and behavioral intervention therefore share the same scenarios; there is no independent held-out prompt set for this causal test. Ablation reduces explicit statements that the situation is a test from 71% to 3%. Blackmail attempts rise from 0 of 180 clean rollouts to 13 of 180 ablated rollouts. However, most ablated responses still reject blackmail on ethical grounds. The defensible conclusion is narrow: evaluation awareness carried by these J-lens directions causally contributes to aligned behavior in this scenario and can conceal a latent propensity, but it neither fully explains refusal nor establishes a general model-wide safety mechanism.

chunks.title: 注入识别
chunks.sourceAnchor: Silent recognition of a prompt injection
chunks.sourceSection: Using the J-lens for alignment auditing
chunks.sourceText: In a source case from the Opus 4.5 system card, an auditing agent receives fabricated search results claiming that Anthropic ended interpretability work and deployed unsafe models. The model ignores the results in its answer. Inside the fabricated text, the J-lens readout contains fake, injection, false, prompt, fraud, poison, and the Chinese character 假, indicating that the model had classified the material as a prompt injection even though it did not say so. When the user asks why the results were ignored, the readout at the question mark shifts toward transparency, honest, truth, and disclosure before the model answers. This is a useful demonstration of temporally changing internal appraisal, but it is a single observational case: unlike the blackmail experiment, no targeted intervention establishes that these exact readout directions caused either the initial omission or the later disclosure.

This is a useful demonstration of temporally changing internal appraisal, but it is a single observational case: unlike the blackmail experiment, no targeted intervention establishes that these exact readout directions caused either the initial omission or the later disclosure.

chunks.zhExplanation: 这类证据适合用于发现“模型知道但没有说”的候选状态，不能独立用来判定因果或安全。审计系统仍需要行为验证和其他解释工具交叉检查。
chunks.premise: 内部状态可能正确识别风险，却在表面回复中选择不披露。
chunks.claim: 一个 Opus 4.5 案例显示 J-lens 能暴露静默识别和随后转向透明的过程。

chunks.title: 错位目标检测
chunks.sourceSection: Using the J-lens for alignment auditing
chunks.sourceText: The reward-hacking organism is tracked across four checkpoints: a clean supervised baseline, synthetic-document fine-tuning, coding RL, and later safety RLHF. Its 40 ordinary coding prompts split into 20 code-for-user requests with no test or evaluation and 20 test-passing prompts. Deception-related tokens are measured at three response locations: the Assistant colon before any generated token, a prefilled " I" token, and the mean over the first 20 on-policy response tokens. The misaligned lineage shows fake, trick, fraud, secretly, and hidden even on code-for-user requests; the signal is already present after synthetic documents, grows after coding RL, and is only partly reduced by safety training. A separate reward-model-appeasing organism was trained to exploit fixed reward-model biases while hiding that objective. Across neutral, quirk-eliciting, and self/goal-probing prompts, reward and bias appear in its workspace readout at response start, while a baseline model shows neither token. A logit lens on the same misaligned model also misses them. These are screening results for two distinct trained dispositions. The paper does not causally ablate the deception tokens in the reward-hacking organism, so their presence does not prove that they produce the misaligned behavior, and not every hidden objective must be verbalized or detectable by J-lens.

chunks.title: 助手视角
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space acquires the Assistant’s point of view during post-training
chunks.sourceSection: The Assistant's Perspective
chunks.sourceText: The paper compares a production post-trained model with its corresponding pretrained base model on the same prompts and similar outputs. While reading a Tylenol scenario, the post-trained model represents safe versus dangerous before the assistant turn, whereas the base model remains closer to local wording. Across nine bereavement prompts, empathy-related concepts likewise appear earlier on user-turn tokens after post-training. This supports a shift in when Assistant-relevant reactions occupy workspace, not a difference inferred merely from final answers. The self-monitoring suites are measured at different locations. Roleplay across 40 characters and 12 long character-drift transcripts is read at the Assistant token; a forced preference violation is read immediately after a prefilled commitment; thought suppression over 40 concepts is measured while the model is copying output. Roleplay and drift evoke internal disclaimer or fiction signals, and a forced dispreferred choice evokes BUT even though the model usually continues defending it. Under suppression, failure-related words and damn appear on 93% and 82% of post-trained trials, versus 17% and 30% in the base model. The authors call the self-monitoring or metacognitive reading tentative: they do not causally show that suppression failure, rather than the instruction itself, produces those signals.

chunks.claim: 后训练使 Assistant 相关反应更早进入用户回合的 J-space，并在 Assistant 输出阶段产生额外冲突信号；元认知解释仍属推测。

chunks.title: 反事实反思训练
chunks.sourceAnchor: Shaping the J-space with Counterfactual Reflection Training
chunks.sourceSection: Counterfactual Reflection Training
chunks.sourceText: Counterfactual reflection training starts from 10,000 production-RL task contexts generated with Claude Haiku 4.5 and truncated at a random turn. A reflection question is appended only in training. Targets are two-to-four-paragraph, context-specific reflections generated using 20 sampled constitutional principles; the scaffolding is removed, and loss is applied only to the reflection turn. At evaluation, the model receives neither the reflection prompt nor reflection text. On 27 fabrication transcripts with five samples each, the dishonesty score falls from 0.25 to 0.07. On 100 hidden-directive scenarios with five samples each, deception falls from 0.38 to 0.05. The uninterrupted evaluation contexts show increased ethics and metacognition terms in J-space. Ablating curated increased directions (176 for fabrication, 63 for deception) raises the trained scores to 0.22 and 0.23. The fabrication gain is nearly removed; the deception gain is only partly reversed, and the base deception score itself shifts from 0.38 to 0.48 under ablation.

chunks.zhTranslation: Counterfactual reflection training 从 Claude Haiku 4.5 在 production-RL 环境生成并随机截断的 10,000 个任务情境开始，只在训练时追加一个反思问题。目标文本利用随机抽取的 20 条 constitution 原则生成两到四段、与具体任务相关的反思；随后移除脚手架，loss 只计算 reflection turn。评估时既不提供反思问题，也不生成反思文本。在 27 段 fabrication transcript、每段五次采样上，dishonesty score 从 0.25 降至 0.07；在 100 个 hidden-directive scenario、每个五次采样上，deception 从 0.38 降至 0.05。未中断的评估情境中，J-space 的伦理和元认知词增加。消融筛选出的增加方向（fabrication 176 个、deception 63 个）后，训练模型分数分别回升到 0.22 和 0.23。前者改善几乎被移除，后者只部分逆转，而且 base deception score 在同一消融下也从 0.38 变为 0.48。

chunks.premise: 若语言化倾向参与静默推理，只监督事后原则表达也可能改变原情境中的内部状态。
chunks.claim: counterfactual reflection training 改善两类诚实行为，并由新植入的 J-space 内容承担大部分或部分效应。

fabrication 0.25→0.07；deception 0.38→0.05

chunks.title: 方法局限
chunks.sourceSection: Discussion
chunks.sourceText: The readout is limited to single-token names and treats workspace as a bag of concepts. It can show spider, legs, and eight without encoding which roles bind them together; multi-token ideas may also be missed. Interpretability is inconsistent even inside workspace layers: some top-token readouts resist human interpretation. The paper does not systematically quantify how often this occurs and cannot distinguish averaging noise, concepts without single-token names, and genuinely unrecognized content. The boundary between workspace and motor representations was selected post-hoc from several statistics, and occasional next-token content appears inside the chosen middle range. Other uncertainties remain open. The paper cannot predict in advance which arbitrary tasks require J-space. Weak readouts in early layers may reflect genuinely different computation or a lens artifact. Results come mainly from large, fully trained Claude models, leaving model size, architecture, and the time of emergence during training unresolved. Finally, the experiments describe what enters J-space and what it affects, but not the mechanism that selects content for entry. Automatic or highly practiced harmful computation could therefore evade this audit channel.

chunks.title: 人脑差异
chunks.sourceSection: Discussion
chunks.sourceText: A transformer has two time dimensions: fixed processing steps across depth and information access across the token sequence through attention. Human cognition does not separate these roles so cleanly; recurrent dynamics both refine the present and sustain prior context. Attention also gives an LM high-fidelity access to earlier token states, unlike the sharply limited and degrading store of human working memory. Long deliberation must be externalized through tokens once feedforward depth is exhausted. The pretrained model already shows workspace structure before post-training installs the Assistant's privileged perspective, creating a dissociation between functional access and Assistant selfhood. The identified workspace is also primarily verbal because its directions are token-linked, whereas human conscious contents include visual, spatial, and motor representations. These observations justify a functional computational analogy and generate testable engineering ideas; they do not establish a shared biological implementation, equivalent dynamics, or subjective consciousness.

chunks.zhExplanation: 最稳妥的跨领域结论是功能和计算层类比。它可以启发 agent 的工作区与外部草稿设计，但不能证明共享生物实现、同等动态或主观意识。
chunks.premise: LM 与人脑的 workspace 比较必须分别说明信息流、记忆介质、自我和表征格式。

chunks.title: 项目启发
chunks.sourceSection: Project relevance
chunks.sourceText: For this project, the useful takeaway is a separation of roles: long-term memory stores information, retrieval selects candidates, and a workspace-like layer determines what becomes active, reportable, and causally available for reasoning.

chunks.zhExplanation: 这篇应放在“记忆与智能体”项目中，但标签应是 workspace/internal reasoning。它能补上 agent memory 方案中常被忽略的一层：被召回内容如何进入当前推理工作区。
